description: This file contains CLI commands for migrating visualization types in the Superset project, including upgrade and downgrade functions, and manages migration classes for various visualization types.

classes.name: VizType
classes.description: Enumeration of different visualization types supported for migration.

methods.name: migrate_viz
methods.description: CLI group for visualization migration commands.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Upgrade visualization(s) to the latest version based on type or ID.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Downgrade visualization(s) to the previous version based on type or ID.

methods.name: migrate_by_viz_type
methods.description: Migrate all charts of a specific visualization type, either upgrade or downgrade.

methods.name: migrate_by_id
methods.description: Migrate specific charts identified by their IDs, either upgrade or downgrade.
